translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content.text: Kaatiyaa naattidan lo"iyaanee!
Ne gedetuu neeni nas'alaa c'aammaa wotsi de'ishshin be'iyaa wode,
ayaa lo"iino! Ne sheechchii eranchcha wogaac'ii k'os's'iide,
loytsi alleek'k'isseeda ink'k'uwaa malatee.
Ne gul"ay woyniyaa eessay kumeedda birilliyaa malatee;
ne s'eessaa yuushshuu c'iishshan k'ashetteedda zarggaa mirk'k'iyaa malatee.
Ne d'antsatuu manttiyaa yeletteedda, gen"ati maratuwaa malatiino.
Ne k'ood'ii danggarssaa zaaliyaan alleek'k'etteedda adussa gimbbiyaa mala.
Ne ayifii wolk'k'aama Haseboona katamaa penggiyaa matan de'iyaa,
zeeruwaa haatsaa malatee.
Ne siid'ii Damask'k'o s'eelissiide gimbbeedda Liibaanoosa gimbbiyaa malatee.
Ne huup'ii K'armmeloosa asaa malatee;
ne olassa binnaanay k'ac'inaa s'aatsaa malatee;
kaatiyaakka ne huup'iyaa datsay nashechcheedda.
Ta siik'k'atee, ne ayaa lo"ay! Ne ayaa malanchchatii!
Ne siik'uu taana ayaa nashechchii!
Ne geesay zambbaa geesaa malatee.
Ne d'antsay zambbaa ayifiyaa wurc'c'uwaa malatee.
Taani, Ha zambbaa gi"ana; Aa maratuwaa oyk'k'ana yaagaad.
Ne d'antsay woyniyaa teeraa wurc'c'uwaa mala;
k'ay ne siid'iyaanna kesiyaa peenuu appiliyaa ayifiyaadan sawee.
Ne yeruu mettershshatuwaappenne achchaappe gidduwaana,
walalattiidde geliyaa woyniyaa mala.
Ubbaappe aad'd'iide mal"iyaa
woyniyaa eessaa mala yaageedda.
Taani ta al"o siik'uwaanno; ikka taana amottee.
Ta siik'ow, haaya; laa"uu katamaappe kesiide biide,
gas'ariyan ak'oytte; k'ammaa laa"uu hewan aatsana.
Wontta guuran ane woyniyaa turaa giddo boytte;
woyniyaa turay c'iisheeddentto, c'iishshiide ayifiyaa dors's'os's'eedenttonne,
k'ay roomaaniikka ayifeeddentto ane be'oytte.
Taani ta siik'uwaa neena hewan bessana.
Inkkoyiyaa ayifiyaa sawuunne hara nashechchiyaa ataakilttiyaa ayifii,
nu karen besseedda; ta siik'oo!
Ha ayifetuwaappe teereeddawanttanne ooratsa mas'eeddawantta,
new ashsha wotsaad.
